sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/104 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 104, search/grid facilities 432 'A Loop', 433 'B Loop', 434 'C Loop', 435 'D & E Loops; Group Camps' for 2027-06-15 and 2027-01-12, search/details for every unit on 2027-06-15, plus sites A003, H1 and A111 on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Non-electric sites $31 a night, electric $41, full hookups $56, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) non-electric $27, electric and full-hookup $37. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all East Harbor campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Non-Electric 31.00 with Maximum Camping Unit Length 25-42 and trailer map icons, Campsite Electric 41.00, Campsite Full Hookup 56.00, Fee 6.50); sites A003, H1, A111 on Sat 2027-06-19 (31.00 / 41.00 / 56.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (27.00 / 37.00 / 37.00), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (electric and full-hookup sites list Electricity Hookup '30/50' or '50'; the 51 full-hookup sites list Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-harbor-state-park-campground ('354 electric sites', '51 full hook-up sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 547 web-bookable RV sites (338 electric, 51 full hookup, 158 non-electric) in Loops A-E; about 146 pull-through. Rated for camping units 20-93 ft: non-electric 25-42, most electric 30-40 with a long pull-through group at 65-85, full hookups 25-93. ODNR counts 354 electric, 51 full-hookup and 168 non-electric sites, plus 10 primitive group camps (no RVs) and two Sherman Cabins. Pets permitted on all sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid (432: 166 units, 433: 130, 434: 227, 435: 36 incl. 10 group camps) + search/details (PullInTypeName, Maximum Camping Unit Length) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-harbor-state-park-campground ('354 electric sites; 4 of these are ADA accessible', '51 full hook-up sites', '168 non-electric sites', '10 primitive Group Camping sites ... No RVs', 'Pets are permitted on all sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Seasonal camp store (April-October); launch ramp and fish-cleaning building for campers. Off-season the dump station stays open and water is at the check-in office.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-harbor-state-park-campground ('Showers, flush toilets, water station and dump station'; 'Launch ramp and fish cleaning building for use by campers'; 'Free WiFi access is available for registered campers'; 'Seasonal Camp Store (April-Oct)'; 'Dump station available and water is available at the check-in office'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak (November 1 to April 1) only electric sites B1-B64 are open (ReserveOhio also sells H1-H4 and non-electric A003-A022 in January).

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-harbor-state-park-campground ('Off-Peak Season: From November 1 to April 1, electric sites B1 through B64 are open.') + ReserveOhio search/grid 2027-01-12 (free: B001-B064, H1-H4, A003-A022; everything else blocked), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations are required for all sites and may be made six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.' Every listed campsite is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-harbor-state-park-campground ('Reservations are required for all sites and may be made six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees confirmed ($31 non-electric RV base, electric +$10, full hookup +$25) and added the off-peak rates. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at the 51 full-hookup sites, 547 RV sites rated to 93 ft with pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/water/dump/camp store/wifi, year-round (B1-B64 in the off-season), ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, reservations required, 14-night max. AWH note kept verbatim. Pin 723 m from the sites' centroid. Not stated: the weekend minimum (left inherited).
